title: nexu-io/open-design
claim: nexu-io/open-design — 🎨 The open-source Claude Design alternative. 🖥️ Local-first desktop app. 🖼️ Your coding agent becomes the design engine:
why_good: An open-source alternative to Anthropic's Claude Design, built as a local-first desktop app: plug in your own coding-agent key — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and 20+ CLIs via BYOK — and that agent becomes the design engine. Describe what you want and it produces prototypes, landing pages, dashboards, slides, even images and video, exporting real HTML / PDF / PPTX / MP4 files right on your machine. Nothing is uploaded to a vendor cloud, so your source files and IP never leave your laptop — the one wedge a Figma-style SaaS can't easily copy.
value: Sell a hosted/team tier and enterprise licenses to design-dev teams who want agent-driven design without shipping their files to a cloud vendor.
risk: Figma and the model vendors can bolt on the same agent-design flow; 'local-first' alone won't hold unless the agent-to-design UX is clearly better.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product in the form of a local-first design application that can be monetized.

zh.claim: nexu-io/open-design —— 开源的「Claude Design」替代品,本地优先的桌面 app:让你的编码 agent 变成设计引擎。
zh.why_good: 一个开源版的「Claude Design」,做成本地优先的桌面 app:接入你自己的编码 agent 密钥——Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini 等 20+ CLI 都能 BYOK 接入——这个 agent 就成了设计引擎。一句话描述,它就在本机生成原型、落地页、仪表盘、幻灯片,甚至图片和视频,并导出真正的 HTML / PDF / PPTX / MP4 文件。全程不上厂商云,文件和 IP 始终留在本机——这正是 Figma 那类 SaaS 难以复制的护城河。
zh.value: 向「想要 agent 驱动设计、又不愿把文件上传云厂商」的设计-研发团队,卖托管/团队版和企业授权。
zh.risk: Figma 和模型厂商随时能接上同样的 agent-设计流程;光靠「本地优先」守不住,除非 agent→设计 的体验明显更好。
zh.hook: 不会设计但想要真交付物（落地页、幻灯片、PDF）的普通人，不想再从聊天框里复制代码片段——三个月 8.2 万星、9500 fork 说明拉力巨大。
zh.does: 本地优先的桌面应用，把 20+ 编码代理 CLI（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor…）变成设计引擎：原型、仪表盘、幻灯片、图片和视频，导出真实文件（HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4），自带密钥。
zh.gap: 给不会设计的人做设计工具，胜负仍取决于谁把代理包装得最好——但这个项目自己正在高速填补这个缺口：390 个贡献者外加自营付费 Cloud。
zh.counter: 你打不过一个有 390 名贡献者、有核心团队和自有变现的项目；任何'轻量克隆'起跑就落后三个月，对面每月还推 515 个提交。
zh.differentiator: 不正面打。开放的侧翼是垂直化：锁定一类人群（教师、房产中介、婚礼策划），配模板、托管、零密钥配置——这些正是横向开源工具刻意不做的部分。
zh.consumer_angle: 本身已面向消费者；未被服务的切片是永远不会配 CLI 和 API key 的非技术用户。
zh.why_use: 今晚就要一份提案 PPT、一张户型图、一页房源单的人，要的不是设计工具，是那个文件。这是本板还放行的唯一一种「面向开发者」形态：AI 直接交出人能用的成品，而不是零件。
zh.edge: 今年之前，agent 会写代码，但交不出你能双击打开的 PPTX / PDF / MP4——你拿到的是一段对话，导出得自己来。真正吐出文件、并且用一个插口接住 20 多个 agent CLI，这才是变了的那一处。

hook: Non-designers who want real deliverables (landing pages, decks, PDFs) out of their coding agent instead of chat snippets — 82k stars and 9.5k forks in three months say the pull is enormous.
does: A local-first desktop app that turns any of 20+ coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor…) into a design engine: prototypes, dashboards, slides, images and video as real exportable files (HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4), BYOK.
gap: Design tooling for people who can't design is still won by whoever packages agents best — but this project itself is filling that gap at speed, with 390 contributors and its own paid Cloud tier.
counter: You cannot out-build a 390-contributor project with a funded core team and its own monetization; any 'lite' clone starts three months behind an org shipping 515 commits a month.
differentiator: Not head-on. The open flank is vertical: one audience (e.g. teachers, real-estate agents, wedding planners) with templates, hosting and zero BYOK setup — the parts a horizontal open-source tool deliberately leaves out.
consumer_angle: Already consumer-facing; the unserved slice is the non-technical user who will never configure a CLI or an API key.
why_use: The person who needs a pitch deck, a floor plan or a listing sheet by tonight does not want a design tool — they want the file. This is the one shape of developer-facing product the board still allows: the AI hands back a finished artefact a human uses, not a part.
edge: Until this year an agent could write code but could not hand you a PPTX, a PDF or an MP4 you could open — you got a chat transcript and did the export yourself. Real file output, plugged into 20+ agent CLIs through one socket, is the thing that changed.
